rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's energy at the start of the turn must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule (S1) holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved S1, "Never fire a shot you can't afford": any shot has power between 100 and 3000 and is always less than the robot's energy. The code fires only when gun heat is 0, using 3000 if energy is above 3000, or energy minus 1 if energy is above 100. The battles did report violations of S2 (first on turn 0) and S3 (first on turn 2) in both the open arena and the city map, but those rules were not part of the verified spec, so they don't affect the S1 proof.
